item.title: EAM Jaishankar arrives in Dhaka for Khaleda Zia's funeral, hands over PM Modi's letter to her son
item.description: In a post on X, the EAM said that upon arrival in Dhaka, he met with Tarique Rahman and handed over to him a personal letter from Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

item.title: 'No communication received': Vodafone Idea on Cabinet relief reports
item.description: In a stock exchange filing, Vodafone Idea said the reports were speculative in nature and that it had not received any official communication confirming such a decision. "We have not received any communication from the Government in relation to the above reported matter," the telecom operator stated in its exchange filing.

item.title: CBI court sentences three to 3-year imprisonment in bank loan fraud case
item.description: CBI investigation revealed that Jayesh Prajapati, along with Alpesh Thakkar, Balmukund Dubey and Dharmesh Dhairya, prepared and used forged documents as genuine to secure the loan. The accused also opened fictitious bank accounts to siphon off the loan amount, thereby cheating Vijaya Bank.

item.title: Ready for another year of even stronger ties with India: US Embassy
item.description: The video also shows glimpses of meeting between External Affairs Minister (EAM) S Jaishankar and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio during the Quad Foreign Ministers Meeting besides the two nations signing a 10-year Update of the Framework for the US-India Major Defence Partnership.

item.title: 'Divine festival of faith, traditions': PM Modi on 2nd anniversary of Ram Mandir's 'Pran Pratishtha'
item.description: In a post on X, PM Modi said, "Today, the second anniversary of the Pran Pratishtha of Ram Lalla is being celebrated on the sacred land of Ayodhya Ji. This anniversary is a divine festival of our faith and traditions. On this holy and pure occasion, from the side of all Ram devotees of the country and abroad, my crores of salutations and obeisance at the feet of Lord Shri Ram! My infinite best wishes to all the countrymen."

item.title: ISKP emerges as Pakistan's new deniable proxy against India
item.description: An Intelligence Bureau official said that plans are already afoot to expand the footprint of the ISKP into India, with the main focus being Jammu and Kashmir. This is a dangerous game that Pakistan is playing, as the final goal is to infiltrate India. item.title: As AQI worsens, Delhi Minister says govt making 'serious efforts' to deal with pollution
item.description: The capital's air quality deteriorated further on Wednesday, slipping into the 'severe' category, with the Air Quality Index (AQI) recorded at 408. Dense fog combined with heavy pollution sharply reduced visibility across large parts of the city, adding to commuter woes.

item.title: 'Beer in hand': Sara Tendulkar's Goa stroll sparks row; netizens call it 'hypocrisy'
item.description: On New Year's Eve, a video of Sachin Tendulkar's daughter, Sara Tendulkar, from Goa went viral, showing her strolling on the streets while drinking beer. Netizens shared mixed reactions, with many objecting to her drinking beer in public, as it was on the streets rather than in closed premises like a club. Several users held the view that open drinking is not permitted even in Goa.

item.title: B-town welcomes 2026: Kareena–Saif get teary-eyed, Aishwarya looks unrecognisable, Hrithik makes hand-heart with Saba
item.description: With that, 2025 comes to an end! Bollywood celebrities bid an emotional, candid, and fun-filled farewell to the year. Some enjoyed romantic date nights, others got cosy in each other's arms, while many ticked off items from their bucket lists. Here's a glimpse at how the stars closed the chapter on 2025 and embraced 2026 with open arms.
